name: Genial Dartfletch
description: Dip the dart tip in a pot of sticky resin and turn it so a thin even coat forms.

name: Sound Mouthpiece
description: Hold the coated dart in warm air and watch the gloss dull to learn when the coat has set.

name: Hearty Airbore
description: Whittle a tiny barb below the point so the dart clings once it has pierced.

name: Rugged Exhale
description: Blow a coated dart at a mid-range target along a level line.

name: Hearty Dartneedle
description: Pick up coated darts only by the tail with a cloth-wrapped finger so bare skin stays clear.

name: Fierce Needlepuff
description: Drive a barbed dart through thick hide with a qi-boosted blow so it hangs in the wound.

name: Levering Cane
description: Blow a spray of warmed resin at a foe's lead hand so the grip sticks fast to its own weapon.

name: Kindly Padhead
description: Rest the long tube's middle on the shoulder to carry the weight while the arms stay loose.

name: Cooling Reedtube
description: Plant a short staff and rest the tube's fore end in its fork for a locked line.

name: Tubetonic
description: Pull in a taller breath to feed the extra length of the bore without a stutter.

name: Canetonic
description: Judge how far the dart will drop over a long run by the mark's size against the sky.

name: Dire Huff
description: Blow a heavy dart down the long bore at a target beyond ordinary tube range.

name: Exhaleglide
description: Lift and replant the staff in two steps to follow a target moving along a path.

name: Puffswat
description: Add qi behind the blow so a dart from the long bore punches through light armor.

name: Rough Puff
description: Blow three paced darts at rising distances to bracket and then strike a far target.

name: Plugslap
description: Aim a body length ahead of a walking target so the dart arrives where the target will be.

name: Canebandage
description: Watch a target's stride for three beats to learn its pace before loading.

name: Puffswerve
description: Turn at the hips and swing the tube smoothly to follow a mark crossing your front.

name: Swift Tube
description: Fire the instant a moving target pauses mid-stride to catch it dead still.

name: Canescorer
description: Add qi to the blow and lead a running target by a wider margin so the fast dart overtakes it.

name: Lassoing Burst
description: Fire across a runner's path so the sting makes it veer or stumble.

name: Kindly Mouthend
description: Fill the lungs in four counts and hold for four before every stalking blow.

name: Purpose Dartfletch
description: Warm the lungs with a few slow breaths in cold air so the blow does not wheeze.

name: Poisetube
description: Spread the ribs wide with a stretch before loading so the chest takes in more air.

name: Rugged Needlepuff
description: Fire on the quiet gap between two heartbeats to keep the tube utterly still.

name: Springing Puff
description: Match each step to the breath cycle while creeping toward game.

name: Sprout Mouthend
description: Walk slowly with long exhales after a hard blow to return the lungs to rest.

name: Static Huff
description: Call on qi stored in the lungs to double the push of one blow at a distant mark.

name: Huffscorer
description: Chain four darts on one qi-fed breath and trade speed for a quick string of shots.

name: Huffscreen
description: Gasp and stumble as if spent to draw a foe in close and then blow a dart point blank.

name: Cooling Plug
description: Hold three darts fanned between the fingers for a fast reload.

name: Prowling Hiss
description: Swing the muzzle in a flat arc to cover a row of marks from left to right.

name: Lunar Dartneedle
description: Count the targets in a knot and pick the nearest and the weakest first.

name: Plugtonic
description: Seat three light darts together in a short wide bore for a spread rather than a single hit.

name: Cooling Cane
description: Flick a fresh dart from the fan into the bore with the thumb in half a beat.

name: Rough Hiss
description: Blow three light darts at once so they spread across a small group at close range.

name: Dawn Airbore
description: Fan a qi-driven hail of tiny darts across a loose line of foes so each takes a light sting.

name: Momenthuff
description: Keep up a quick sweeping flurry of darts to pin a group behind cover.

name: Dawntube
description: Stow a short tube along the forearm inside a wide sleeve so it does not show.

name: Sproutcane
description: Carry the tube inside a hollow walking cane and slip the cap off with one thumb.

name: Brawn Tube
description: Lift the hand to the face as if to cough and bring the mouthpiece to the lips unseen.

name: Soothing Plug
description: Watch the gaps between people to find a clear line for a quiet dart.

name: Exhale Scorer
description: Blow a dart under cover of a cough at a target a few paces away.

name: Comet Reedtube
description: Place a qi-pointed dart through a gap in the target's garments from a hidden tube.

name: Lassoing Padhead
description: Palm the tube away at the instant of discovery so a searcher finds only empty hands.

name: Purpose Mouthpiece
description: Pair two steps to each in-breath and out-breath while jogging to keep the lungs even.

name: Gritburst
description: Halt within one stride and settle the tube level before the shot.

name: Sleet Padhead
description: Lean into a slope and tilt the muzzle to offset the ground's pitch before the blow.

name: Hum Cane
description: Feel the beat of your footfalls and fire on the same part of each stride.

name: Static Burst
description: Blow a dart as the rear foot lands during a short retreat.

name: Poise Reedtube
description: Reload one-handed during a skipping step without breaking stride.

name: Recall Mouthend
description: Wet a finger to feel the cross breeze and shift the muzzle to counter it.

name: Draught Exhale
description: Fire a qi-driven dart without slowing and trust rhythm over a settled stance.

name: Hum Dartfletch
description: Weave left and right on the approach and blow a dart at each turning point.

name: Scudding Hiss
description: Run in short bursts tied to qi-fed breaths so the lungs never fail mid-fight.

name: Plugscreen
description: Turn the tube crosswise to knock aside a thrusting knife at close quarters.

name: Dartneedle Carapace
description: Keep the mouth end tucked behind a raised forearm to guard the lips from a blow.

name: Hungry Mouthpiece
description: Jab the muzzle into the soft of a foe's ribs to gain a breath of room.

name: Hum Needlepuff
description: Press the muzzle to a foe's clothing and blow so the dart cannot miss.

name: Brasstube
description: Whip the qi-hardened tube across a seizing hand and blow as it recoils.

name: Gagging Airbore
description: Blow a stinging dart at gripping fingers to break a hold on the tube.
